title: CLCON/337/2021 of MOHAN CHANDRA UPRETI Vs KUBER SINGH BISHT

paras.text:
HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Contempt Petition No. 337 of 2021
Mohan Chandra Upreti ........Petitioner

Present:-
Mr. Harendra Belwal, Advocate for the petitioner.
Mr. Rajesh Joshi, Standing Counsel for the State.
Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)
 The instant contempt petition has been filed on
the ground that the respondent has defied the directions
of the Court dated 21.12.2020, passed in WPSS No.1757
of 2020, Mohan Chandra Upreti Vs. State of Uttarakhand
and others.
2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and
perused the record.
3. The contempt petitioner has brought to the
notice of the Court that the order dated 21.12.2020,
passed by this Court in WPSS No.1757 of 2020, Mohan
Chandra Upreti Vs. State of Uttarakhand and others, has
been wilfully disobeyed by the contemnor. The relevant
portion of the order is as hereunder:-

2
 "Accordingly, the present writ petition is
disposed of with a direction to the respondents
authorities to take direction on the representation of
the petitioner dated 13.12.2017 by passing a speaking
and reasoned order preferably within eight weeks from
the date of receipt of this order."
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner would
submit that after the order of the Court dated
21.12.2020, the representation of the contempt petitioner
has though been decided by the contemnor, but what was
admitted to be paid to the petitioner, that amount has yet
not been paid.
5. In fact, during the hearing of this contempt
proceedings, on 06.01.2022, the Court passed the
following order:-
 "Learned Standing Counsel has apprised the
Court that Conservator of Forest, who is the Competent
Authority, has decided petitioner's representation, vide
order dated 22.03.2021. He further submits that since
petitioner has to be paid a sum of ` 1,58,378/- as
interest, therefore, the Conservator has requested the
State Government to release necessary funds, vide
letter dated 09.08.2021.

3
 Learned Standing Counsel assures the Court
that amount due to the petitioner, as interest, would be
paid as soon as necessary funds are received from the
State Government.
In such view of the matter, the contempt petition
is closed. Contempt notice issued to respondent no. 2
is hereby discharged. However, petitioner shall be at
liberty to seek recall of this order, if the amount
payable as interest, is not paid to him."
6. Subsequently, it was brought to the notice of
the Court that the amount has not been paid, therefore,
the order dated 06.01.2022 has been recalled on
14.03.2023. On the last date of hearing, i.e. on
26.04.2023, learned State Counsel had submitted that he
has no instructions despite letters having been issued to
the concerned Divisional Forest Officer. It is under those
circumstances that the Court required personal presence
of the Divisional Forest Officer, Additional Soil
Conservation, Forest Division, Ramnagar, District
Nainital. He is present before the Court.
7. Mr. Naveen Chandra Pant, the respondent
no.2, would submit that payment is not made at his level.
He has already demanded the budget from the State

4
Counsel, which has been sanctioned , and within two
months, the payment would be made.
8. The Court takes on record the statement.
9. In fact, by the order dated 21.12.2020, the
Court has directed the contemnor to decide the
representation. That has already been decided. That is
another aspect as to how far the contempt proceedings
may be stretched beyond what was directed to be done by
the order dated 21.12.2020 passed in WPSS No.1757 of
2020, but the Court leaves it at it.
10. Nothing survives in this petition. It stands
disposed of, accordingly.
 (Ravindra Maithani, J.)
 04.05.2023
Ravi Bisht
